description: Arch-guild hooks: load project ratchet at session start

hooks.command: RATCHET_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ "$SKIP_GUILD_RATCHET" = "1" ]; then echo '[Guild Ratchet: Skipped via SKIP_GUILD_RATCHET=1]'; elif [ -f "$RATCHET_ROOT/.claude/guild-ratchet.md" ]; then echo '[Guild Ratchet: Loading project learnings from .claude/guild-ratchet.md]'; cat "$RATCHET_ROOT/.claude/guild-ratchet.md"; else echo '[Guild Ratchet: No .claude/guild-ratchet.md found - fresh session]'; fi
